_doc: 012/P1-5 golden eval corpus. Synthetic, deterministic, text-only (runs on MvpSystem). No real PII/tenant/fund data. Each question carries a unique identifier token present only in its target document so deterministic retrieval is stable. Used by tests/integration/test_golden_corpus.py against the committed baseline tests/fixtures/eval/golden_baseline.json. ★G2 adds an unanswerable slice (answerability=unanswerable): ALL categories now REFUSE and are hard-gated (unanswerable_answer_rate ceiling 0.0). category unanswerable_in_domain (a question about ABSENT in-domain content) formerly answered via a grounded-but-irrelevant extraction and was held by a ratchet; that gap is CLOSED by the default-ON salient-term coverage gate (GroundednessGate.salient_coverage_check — all question identifiers plus >=50% of its salient lexical terms must appear in the used evidence). Wave 1c adds a synonym slice (category=synonym, manufacturing): the question names a tenant-approved synonym (retrieval.synonyms lexicon, seeded from the top-level `lexicon` block by the harness) while the target document carries the canonical surface form, next to a distractor document sharing the family/component vocabulary. Without query expansion the distractor deterministically outranks the gold (MRR floor fails); with the tenant lexicon the gold ranks first. Coverage-gate contract: the salient-coverage no-answer gate keeps judging the ORIGINAL query, so these questions carry enough directly-covered salient terms to pass it — a question responsive ONLY through a synonym still refuses by design.

Press machine EQ-PRESS-100 alarm E-200 indicates a hydraulic pressure drop; inspect the accumulator and recharge it.

The monthly inspection checklist for the temperature system requires measuring thermocouple resistance on every production cycle.

射出成形機の油圧ユニットで圧力変動が発生した場合の対処手順: 電磁弁の作動状態と配管の締結状態を点検する。
搬送コンベアの減速機で油漏れが発生した時の点検手順: シールパッキンの劣化を確認し、必要なら新品に交換する。
搬送コンベアの減速機で異常振動が発生した場合の点検手順: 取付ボルトの緩みと駆動チェーンの張りを確認する。
CNC旋盤の主軸ベアリングで異音が発生した時の対応手順: グリスを補給し、改善しなければベアリングを交換する。
CNC旋盤の主軸ベアリングで発熱が発生した場合の対応手順: 潤滑ユニットの吐出量と冷却水の流量を確認する。

lexicon._doc: Per-namespace tenant lexicon entries the harness seeds via LexiconService.update (actor_id=golden-harness) and attaches to RetrievalService — the same wiring the deployed answer-service uses. retrieval.synonyms: key = canonical document term, values = query-side synonyms (symmetric group expansion).
